name: Motion
role: Motion (ex Framer Motion): hybrid JS/React animation, springs, layout and scroll
summary: Animation library for JavaScript and React (import motion/react), successor to Framer Motion. animate() drives DOM, SVG and values with springs, keyframes and stagger, and returns controls whose time can be set. Strong at layout transitions, gestures and scroll-linked effects in React UI. Releases are frequent. Capture needs a harness that sets time, not wall-clock playback.
use_when: React UI scenes needing layout animation and springs
Over React Spring for the broader API and vanilla JS animate()
Scroll-linked or gesture-driven motion in a captured page
avoid_when: Non-React sequencing with labels and plugins: GSAP
Physics-style springs on arbitrary values: React Spring
notes: 2026-10-26: time-settable controls read from docs; deterministic offline seeking not tested. Some features are paid (Motion+); core is MIT.

assessment.rationale: Active: motion 14.6.0 published 2026-10-22, MIT. Large React/vanilla user base; complements GSAP for React UI and springs.
